All substantive prose (summary, brief, top_lines, sections[].items, changes.added, gaps, likelihoodReason) decomposed; 41 affirmative/synthesis claims SUPPORTED verbatim against source, 0 material and 0 minor prose errors. 2 minor qualifiers ('local company' / 'Wisconsin company') infer the buyer's locality, which the source does not state (buyer named exactly; parcel is in WI) - low impact. 2 minor coverage omissions (Sec 2(d) 300-day appraisal deadline + standards; Sec 2(b)(2)/(c)(1) Map/valid-existing-rights/discretionary terms). likelihoodReason process facts (sponsor party, Senate committee report) are structural metadata corroborated by cache sponsor/versions[] and are kept per rubric class 8, not flagged; 'passed the House' is confirmed verbatim in the source endorsement. Out of source scope: versionChanges.removed (Introduced-version hazmat carve-out struck) requires the Introduced text, which is not registered as a referencedSource - the EH source's subsection (e) is Definitions, consistent with the carve-out having been removed.
